name: Basic Website
description: A page with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No frameworks, no internet.
_offline_note: Section 17 of the Phase 11 work order: a starter website makes no network requests, loads no remote script, no CDN and no web font, and contains no third-party dependency. It works with the Wi-Fi off, and opennest/execution/web_preview.py refuses anything that is not a file inside the project, so a page that grew one would be stopped rather than quietly allowed.
